mobsthinknow.config.title: Mobs Think Now Configuration
Skeletons, Strays, Bogged, and Parched receive intelligence 1-10 and share smart ranged tactics. Any current hostile target, including players and iron golems, can trigger full disengagement.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_crossbows.t: Naturally spawned regular skeletons may replace their bow with a crossbow and use a real loading, aiming, strafing, and firing state machine.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_crossbow_ch: Default: 18%. Final probability also scales with difficulty and individual intelligence.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_firework_cr: Default: 25%, rolled only for crossbowmen with intelligence 7-10. Ammunition is finite, close targets trigger disengagement, and ordinary arrows take over after rockets run out.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_preferred_r: Default: 10. Close-range bow combat backpedals while keeping aim, targets beyond roughly 135% or out of sight are approached, and the middle band strafes continuously.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_emergency_d: When any current hostile target closes in, lower the bow or crossbow and run forward along an escape path at the highest movement priority. Trigger range, safe range, and speed increase with intelligence 1-10. Each attempt lasts at most four seconds.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_cover_peeki: Search nearby cover with a fixed budget: draw while hidden, sidestep into the adjacent firing cell without losing aim, stabilize for two ticks, shoot, hold the target-facing shot pose for two ticks, then withdraw. Arrow dodging and full escape always take priority.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_firing_lane: After repeated allied obstruction, a skeleton lowers its weapon and checks at most four reachable side positions for a predicted clear arc. Charged firework crossbows also keep squadmates outside the blast radius.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_projectile_: Every three ticks, query arrows within seven blocks and dodge only trajectories predicted to cross the safety radius within eight ticks. No world-wide projectile scan is used.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_predictive_: Adds at most eight ticks and three blocks of horizontal lead from target velocity; vanilla vertical compensation and difficulty spread remain intact.
mobsthinknow.config.skeleton_aim_predict: Default: 65%, further scaled by difficulty so Easy, Normal, and Hard become progressively more accurate. Zero adds no lead.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_ai_enabled.t: Regular creepers receive intelligence 1-10 and smart approach, feint, and fuse goals. Hard difficulty raises the birth range. Disabling this delegates approach and fuse lifecycles to vanilla behavior.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_flanking.too: Creepers at intelligence 6 or higher seek a stable side-rear point while watched or facing a raised shield. Individual side assignment spreads groups without scanning every ally.
Preserves the vanilla 30-tick fuse and initial hiss, but continues toward a velocity-predicted blast point. Creating enough distance makes the fuse recede.
Unpowered creepers at intelligence 8-10 may hiss for only 6-8 ticks outside the real fuse envelope while watched or facing a shield, then defuse and move to a side-rear point. Riders and committed fuses never feint.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_fuse_feint_c: Range 80-600 ticks, default 240. Each use is staggered to 80%-120% so nearby creepers do not flash in sync.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_squad_evacua: When a squad creeper starts hissing, non-breach members pause combat and follow reachable paths outside the real damage envelope; charged creepers use a larger safety zone. The coordinator indexes only active fuses instead of making every mob scan every ally.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_blast_reserv: Ordinary squad creepers do not commit overlapping fuses against the same target or area; queued breachers wait on a flank outside the danger radius. Irreversible externally ignited fuses are still registered so allies can evacuate from the predicted blast center.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_wall_breachi: Creepers at intelligence 8 or higher may retain their fuse through the first obstacle with explosion resistance at most 20 after recently seeing the target. Obsidian, bedrock, and worlds with mobGriefing disabled are excluded.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_maximum_fuse: Range: 3-5, default 4. Low intelligence interpolates from vanilla's 3 blocks; charged creepers add half a block while retaining the full fuse.
mobsthinknow.config.creeper_fuse_movemen: Range: 100%-150%, default 125%. Intelligence and difficulty determine actual speed; only high-intelligence Hard individuals reach the cap.
Regular endermen gain intelligence 1-10, while vanilla staring, pumpkin disguise, damage anger, and persistent anger rules remain unchanged. Extra tactics run only after a survival player is already targeted.
mobsthinknow.config.enderman_creeper_del: When an already-hostile player is far enough away, an enderman reserves a nearby unprimed creeper, carries it to a close delivery position, releases and ignites it, pauses briefly, then retries its retreat teleport until it escapes. Vanilla stare freezing still applies before arrival; a committed arrival completes its drop and retreat.
mobsthinknow.config.enderman_creeper_sea: Range 6-32, default 16. Lower-intelligence endermen use only part of it. Each search checks at most 24 candidates and shares a leased single-target reservation with spider carriers.
mobsthinknow.config.enderman_creeper_del: Range 5-60 seconds, default 15. Intelligence shortens it slightly, then a random offset staggers multiple endermen.
mobsthinknow.config.enderman_creeper_dro: Range 2-6, default 3 blocks. Front deliveries use a narrow view cone and check terrain, fluids, collision, and vertical separation before releasing the payload.
mobsthinknow.config.enderman_creeper_fro: Range 0%-100%, default 80%. Front deliveries put the payload in a close position inside the player's current view; the remaining chance attacks from behind.
mobsthinknow.config.sunlight_survival.to: Any burning zombie seeks reachable water and requests squad water support; daylight exposure also triggers shade seeking. Only the daylight-only state yields to a recent attack.
mobsthinknow.config.smart_traversal.tool: Reject open doors, gates, and trapdoors whose real collision no longer supports footing, and physically jump a one-block gap toward a target when the landing is safe.
mobsthinknow.config.maximum_coordinated_: Allowed range: 4-100. Higher values increase coordination and vanilla pathfinding costs.
mobsthinknow.config.dynamic_squad_replan: Two confirmed failures on the same assigned route let the leader check a bounded set of fallback orders, issue a new plan epoch, and then apply a per-member cooldown.
mobsthinknow.config.observable_target_ta: Squads adapt only to tactics a member can truly see: shielding, high ground, kiting, choke points, or water defense. Evidence uses hysteresis and expires instead of reading hidden player state.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_shared_danger_: Members publish confirmed path failures to a bounded, expiring squad blackboard of at most 32 positions. Later rally, deployment, and firing-lane sidesteps skip those cells; both capacity and path sampling are fixed-budget.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_firing_lane_re: Drawing bows and charging crossbows briefly broadcast their predicted trajectory. Ground allies blocking it check one reachable sidestep on either side; explosive-firework lanes also clear the target blast zone.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_threat_distrib: Only real attackers and newly visible enemies enter a bounded memory of eight threats. The leader may assign at most 40% of eligible members to two secondary targets while at least 60% keep pressure on the primary target.
mobsthinknow.config.briefing_ticks.toolt: Range: 60-100 ticks; default 64 (3.2 seconds). Nearby contact or a fresh attack still interrupts immediately.
mobsthinknow.config.regroup_ticks.toolti: Range: 40-80 ticks; default 48 (2.4 seconds), including the scan, succession salute, and staggered acknowledgements.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_visual_effects: Briefing call-and-response chatter, the leader's golden aura, role-colored deployment trails and the engage war cry.
mobsthinknow.config.zombie_profession_sk: Client-side visual only: gives recruits, swordsmen, axemen, both guards, engineers, water support, lava harassers and air-assault troops distinct pixel skins. Disable it to use vanilla or resource-pack textures.
mobsthinknow.config.zombie_body_language: Client-side visual only: adds rally calls, scans, nods and objections, loadout-specific idles, succession gestures, combat windups, and engineer work. Real attacks, blocking, eating, and flight keep higher pose priority.
mobsthinknow.config.zombie_animation_ble: Range: 0-8, default 4. Cross-fades interrupted or early-finished tactical poses into their successor to remove arm, head, and body snapping; zero keeps instant switching.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_role_name_tags: Shows a colored role suffix above squad members while they are grouped; original names are restored when they leave.
mobsthinknow.config.individual_traits.to: Newly spawned zombies receive varied speed, maximum health, attack damage, and follow range. Higher difficulties raise the averages. Stable individual voices are always enabled as presentation.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_tactics.tool: A zombie retreats when an attack leaves it at 20% health or less, or removes 30% of its maximum health in one hit; it re-engages upon reaching safe distance or its hard time limit.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_heavy_hit_th: Retreat when one hit removes this percentage of maximum health. Uses final health lost after armor, enchantments, absorption, and shield blocking.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_maximum_seco: A hard limit measured from retreat start. Further hits update the escape direction but never extend this deadline.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_safe_distanc: End the retreat early once horizontal distance from the current attacker reaches this value; default is 5 blocks.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_speed_percen: Path speed relative to normal movement. Defaults to 150% for a more decisive disengage.
mobsthinknow.config.food_scavenging.tool: Medium- and high-intelligence zombies below half health may seek reachable food within 12 blocks, eat one serving, and heal by its nutrition value.
mobsthinknow.config.food_minimum_intelli: Only zombies at or above this intelligence can scavenge. Default: 6. Smarter zombies act on each search opportunity more often.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_tactics.tool: Smart zombies visibly mine basic soft blocks, then pillar one block at a time against iron golems or elevated targets. This always respects mobGriefing.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_minimum_inte: Only supported ground zombie-family members at or above this intelligence can gather and pillar. Default: 8.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_block_invent: Maximum hidden building-block stack, from 3 to 16. Default: 8. Remaining blocks drop on death.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_skills.tool: A small share of eligible smart zombies become engineers, while water- and lava-bucket variants join the same profession automatically. After each skill, they wait 6-10 seconds before selecting an available TNT, water, lava, or direct-ignition action.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_spawn_chanc: Default: 8% among adult, high-intelligence, empty-handed candidates without an air-assault profession. Water- and lava-bucket variants become engineers automatically. Effective odds scale slightly with difficulty.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_tnt_skill.t: Allows engineers to place and ignite TNT at a safe cell near the target, then withdraw. Sites near allied zombies are rejected, and both mobGriefing and tntExplodes are respected.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_fluid_skill: Lets every engineer temporarily use water and lava buckets near a target, withdraw, then return to recover the real source block. Respects mobGriefing.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_ignition_sk: Lets engineers approach a target that is not burning and ignite it for five seconds after a short visible flint-and-steel windup.
mobsthinknow.config.armed_squads.tooltip: Off by default. Raises weapon-carry odds with difficulty and may produce sword or axe zombies with shields.
mobsthinknow.config.weapon_combat_tactic: All sword and axe zombies respect item attack-speed cooldowns and circle while waiting. Axe leaps now have a readable windup, while swordsmen can probe a raised shield.
mobsthinknow.config.sword_feints.tooltip: Smart swordsmen sometimes fake a lunging swing without dealing damage. Dropping the shield commits them to a real strike; holding it makes them retreat into recovery.
mobsthinknow.config.sword_feint_minimum_: Only sword zombies at or above this intelligence understand feints. Default: 7.
mobsthinknow.config.sword_feint_chance.t: Chance for each eligible attack cycle to become a feint. A fixed retry delay prevents per-tick rerolls.
mobsthinknow.config.shield_bashes.toolti: After a real successful block, smart guards may lower defense and bash with the offhand shield on a dedicated hit frame, then return to guard.
mobsthinknow.config.shield_bash_minimum_: Only guards at or above this intelligence convert a successful block into a bash. Default: 7.
mobsthinknow.config.shield_bash_chance.t: Rolled once per genuine block. If it does not trigger, the existing delayed weapon counter is used.
mobsthinknow.config.shield_bash_damage.t: The slider value divided by ten is the actual damage. Default: 20, or 2 damage.
mobsthinknow.config.spear_air_assault.to: Naturally spawned spear zombies receive an elytra and 16-64 rockets. They launch nearly vertically, use 1-2 rockets during each short orbit, and enter a spear dive before the 3.6-second hard deadline. They keep their normal ground pose without a target.
mobsthinknow.config.special_equipment.to: Allows empty-handed adult zombies to spawn with fluid buckets. Water carriers always wear Depth Strider III boots. This is independent from the experimental Armed Squads toggle.
mobsthinknow.config.fluid_tactics.toolti: Water carriers reliably screen their retreats and pour water at burning squadmates' feet; lava carriers deploy under their current target. Both use vanilla bucket sounds and recover their source.
Default: 4%. The effective chance rises slightly with world and regional difficulty.
mobsthinknow.config.lava_bucket_chance.t: Default: 2%. Lava carriers skip cells occupied by friendly zombies and try adjacent positions.
mobsthinknow.config.special_equipment_dr: Default: 85 per mille (8.5%), exactly matching the vanilla Mob equipment-slot chance. Applies to newly spawned carriers.
mobsthinknow.config.server_authority_not: This screen directly affects only singleplayer and locally hosted servers. For a dedicated server, edit its config and run /mtn reload.

mobsthinknow.config.spider_ai_enabled.to: Regular spiders receive intelligence 1-10 and replace pounce/melee goals; cave spiders retain their vanilla poison rhythm. Disabling this delegates both personal-combat goal lifecycles to vanilla behavior.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_predictive_po: Spiders at intelligence 4 or higher may lead a moving target from 2.5-7 blocks before pouncing. Horizontal and vertical launch speeds remain hard-capped.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_hit_and_run.t: Spiders at intelligence 5 or higher keep facing the target after a hit, orbit to a side-rear pounce distance, then attack again.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_creeper_coord: Nearby allies sharing a target rendezvous and form a real riding pair. The spider rushes a predicted position, then lets the creeper use its full vanilla fuse inside delivery range.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_transport_rou: Before boarding and on delivery reroutes, sample at most 16 path nodes for combined height, width, and dangerous drops. Two failures before fuse commitment trigger a safe adjacent dismount and cooldown.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_creeper_searc: Range: 4-16, default 8. Each spider queries only local space every 10-20 ticks; single-target leases prevent multiple carriers claiming one creeper.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_creeper_carri: Range: 110%-170%, default 140%. A spider carrying a creeper, skeleton, or zombie rolls 88%-100% of this value as its own cap, then intelligence and difficulty interpolate upward from 110%.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_spiders.s: Spawned %s tactical spider archetypes: hunter, ambusher, alpha, and creeper carrier.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_spiders.n: No nearby ground has enough safe space for the complete spider test formation.

mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_spiders.a: Adding the spider formation failed; this spawn attempt was rolled back.
Spawned %s tactical enderman archetypes: hunter and preloaded creeper teleporter.
No nearby ground has enough safe space for the complete enderman test formation.
Creating an enderman or creeper payload failed; no test formation was spawned.
Adding the enderman formation failed; this spawn attempt was rolled back.
mobsthinknow.config.spear_rocket_efficie: 100% matches vanilla attached fireworks; default 50%. Stable boost speed is about half vanilla, which also lowers kinetic spear damage. Each launched rocket synchronizes this value to clients.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_ai_enab: Enables difficulty-scaled zombie-to-giant birth replacement, full Giant combat goals, mixed-squad leadership, a head-top ranged seat, and two independent hand payload slots.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_spawn_c: Range 0-100 per mille, default 10 (1%). Easy uses 40% of this chance, Normal uses it directly, and Hard doubles it. Command, load, conversion, and jockey spawns are excluded.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_maximum: Range 40-400, default 160. Applied to both newly converted and loaded Giants.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_attack_: Range 4-40, default 14. Giants retain high knockback and armor while moving more slowly than ordinary zombies.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_movemen: Attribute base value from 8%-22%, default 16%. Mixed-squad speed bonuses do not stack on an assigned Giant carrier.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_payload: A squad skeleton may jump onto the Giant head. The Giant reserves up to two creepers or zombies, visibly holds one in each hand, and throws them toward the target with staggered ballistic launches.
mobsthinknow.config.giant_zombie_melee_a: Adds limited windup tracking, a pre-impact direction lock, collision-safe steps, sweeps, palm strikes, stomps, shield-punishing kicks, grabs, and a two-handed ground smash. A heavy hit interrupts a grab and safely drops its passenger.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_giants.su: Spawned %s giant siege platform archetypes (%s total entities).
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_giants.no: No nearby ground has the full twelve-block clearance required by a giant siege platform.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_giants.cr: Preparing the Giant, head rider, and two hand payloads failed; nothing was added.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_giants.ad: Adding the giant siege platform failed; this spawn attempt was rolled back.
mobsthinknow.config.nether_ai_enabled.to: Master switch for Nether tactics. Piglins, brutes, blazes, ghasts, hoglins, zoglins, and magma cubes retain vanilla AI when disabled.
mobsthinknow.config.piglin_formation_tac: Crossbow users take deterministic firing lanes, melee piglins approach the target's rear flanks, and brutes hold the center. Each piglin picks a lane in O(1) without scanning every ally.
mobsthinknow.config.blaze_combat_tactics: Blazes orbit at their preferred range and withdraw when crowded. Easy, Normal, and Hard use two-, three-, and four-shot volleys; disabling this restores the vanilla attack goal.
mobsthinknow.config.blaze_preferred_rang: Range 7-16 blocks, default 10. Stable per-entity orbit directions keep a group from stacking on the same side of its target.
mobsthinknow.config.nether_prediction_st: Default 70%. Adds bounded velocity lead to blaze and ghast shots while vanilla projectile physics, collision, explosions, and blaze difficulty spread remain in force.
mobsthinknow.config.ghast_artillery_tact: Expands the ghast's vertical acquisition band from four to sixteen blocks, predicts moving targets, and relocates after firing while retaining the vanilla sound and 20-tick charge.
mobsthinknow.config.hoglin_charge_tactic: Adult hoglins and zoglins wind up between six and thirteen blocks, verify support and clearance, then charge once before a fixed cooldown. They do not launch across cliffs or gaps.
Range 85%-145%, default 115%. Controls charge navigation and a bounded launch impulse rather than overwriting physics every tick.
mobsthinknow.config.magma_cube_predictiv: Each real takeoff freezes one predicted target point and adds horizontal velocity for that jump. Vanilla jump delay, height, and contact damage remain unchanged.
mobsthinknow.config.magma_cube_pounce_sp: Range 35%-100%, default 68%. Size and difficulty only apply a small scale so large magma cubes do not cross unreasonable distances.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_nether.no: No nearby space can safely fit every Nether ground and flying archetype.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_nether.cr: Preparing the Nether combat formation failed; no entities were added.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all_nether.ad: Adding the Nether combat formation failed; the complete attempt was rolled back.
mobsthinknow.config.nether_profession_sk: Selects distinct pixel textures for adult Piglins, Blazes, Ghasts, Hoglins, Zoglins, and Magma Cubes from their persistent server-synced profession. Disabling this restores vanilla or resource-pack visuals without changing profession tactics.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_web_traps.too: Regular spiders at intelligence 7-10 read target velocity, perform a 0.4-second silk tell, and place a temporary web at a predicted footfall. Obeys mobGriefing, caps each dimension at 128 webs, and restores blocks on expiry, unload, or shutdown.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_web_trap_cool: Range: 80-600, default 240 (12 seconds). Intelligence and difficulty reduce at most 36 ticks, then each spider adds 0-40 ticks of desynchronizing jitter.
mobsthinknow.config.spider_web_trap_life: Range: 60-400, default 160 (8 seconds). Cleanup only restores blocks registered by this mod that are still cobwebs; player replacements are preserved.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_casualty_extra: During combat, select only the lowest-health non-creeper casualty. A healthy shield bearer moves between the threat and casualty, blocks and counterattacks at melee range, while the casualty runs forward out of contact. One pair per squad and no O(N squared) scans.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_casualty_healt: Range: 10%-50%, default 30%. The response ends after recovery to threshold plus 20%, reaching 10 blocks from the threat, or timing out.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_casualty_respo: Range: 40-120, default 60 (3 seconds). A fixed 80-tick cooldown after each response prevents a low-health member from retreating forever.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_web_ambush_fol: When a target enters a temporary web placed by this squad's spider, the leader grants skeletons a six-tick staggered volley window, then releases melee, carrier, and demolition members for a 24-tick synchronized charge. Escaping before the order cancels the charge; each squad then cools down for 120 ticks.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_spider_casualt: When no healthy shield bearer is available, an idle spider with intelligence 6 or higher is preferred over an unshielded walking escort. The casualty visibly leaps onto its back, rides away from the threat, and dismounts at a safe position.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_shield_wall_ro: In shield-wedge or combined-arms plans, two or more frontal shield bearers take distinct slots in rows of up to five. Everyone guards while holding formation; during commit and exploit windows only one member attacks every 16 ticks while the others maintain cover.
